verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers team workspaces, request sharing via widgets, and an embeddable mini-client that could support ad-hoc portal-like sharing, but there is no evidence of a purpose-built API catalog/discovery portal (e.g., searchable directory, published documentation site, API network) — community feedback even notes it can't generate documentation for folders/requests. missing for 10: a dedicated catalog/portal feature, discovery/search across published APIs, generated API documentation, and any independent evidence of teams actually using it as an internal API marketplace.
